intended_object: The morphism X → ∫_j F(j,j) into an end that the end's universal property gives. It is induced by a family f_j : X → F(j,j) satisfying the wedge (dinaturality) condition. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The hypothesis hf asks, for every g : i ⟶ j, that f i followed by F(i,g) : F(i,i) → F(i,j) equals f j followed by F(g,j) = (F.map g.op).app j : F(j,j) → F(i,j). This is exactly the standard wedge condition. The body delegates to Multifork.IsLimit.lift, because Mathlib defines a wedge as a multifork, so the result is the induced map into the limit. J and C are arbitrary categories with arbitrary universe levels, so the generality is the natural one. Mathlib has no separate definition of this lift; the more general Multifork.IsLimit.lift is the construction it specializes to the wedge shape on purpose.
